title: POS Payment Methods
description: Configure cash, card, and other till payment methods.

help.title: About POS Payment Methods
help.overview: A payment method is cash or card. A POS config chooses which methods its till offers. Name and type are required. Sequence is the order the buttons appear on the till.

sections.title: How the till takes payment
sections.body: Cash and card are separate methods. A till must keep at least one method assigned.
items: Cash can list quick amounts as comma-separated values, for example 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 20. An empty list uses the built-in chips.
Card turns the terminal path on. Manual means the cashier confirms the charge. Local HTTP talks to a terminal bridge using protocol, host, port, terminal id, and path.
Deactivating a method hides it from new payments. Deleting a method is a soft delete and it can be restored.
